title: Royalty Offset: King - Man + Woman = Queen
explanation: The most famous analogy in NLP. Subtracting the male concept from 'king' leaves royalty; adding 'woman' points directly to 'queen' in vector space.

title: Capital & Country: Paris - France + Japan = Tokyo
explanation: Captures the geopolitical relationship: Vector(France -> Paris) is the capital relation. Adding this relation to Japan results in Tokyo.

title: Juvenile Animals: Puppy - Dog + Cat = Kitten
explanation: Captures the age relation: Vector(Dog -> Puppy) represents juvenile offspring. Applied to Cat, it lands on Kitten.

title: Grammar Inflection: Walking - Walk + Swim = Swimming
explanation: Demonstrates morphological regularity: continuous participle suffix -ing is an almost identical linear shift across regular and irregular verbs.

title: Adjective Degree: Faster - Fast + Tall = Taller
explanation: Captures the comparative degree offset: Vector(Fast -> Faster) encodes the concept of 'more intense degree', shifting Tall to Taller.
